heading: Your self-issued IDs
sub: A wallet can sign you in with an ID Token it signs with its own key (Self-Issued OpenID Provider v2). Nobody vouches for that key, so it signs in only the person who enrolled it here.
subject: Subject
label: Label
enrolNote: Your wallet is asked for a self-issued ID Token, and the key that signed it is enrolled for you — you prove you hold it; nothing is typed.
off: Signing in with a self-issued ID is turned off here, so no wallet can be enrolled from this page. The keys above stay enrolled.
doneEnrolled: Your wallet's key is enrolled. It signs you in from now on.
doneRemoved: That key no longer signs you in.
